# iii **More application. Less infrastructure.** Connect any functions, agents, APIs, models, browsers, infrastructure, and machines into one live, composable system. [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/iii-hq/iii?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/iii-hq/iii/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/iii-hq/iii?label=release)](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/releases) [![Contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/iii-hq/iii)](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/graphs/contributors) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0%20%2B%20ELv2-blue)](#license) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/iii-sdk?label=npm&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/iii-sdk?label=npm%20downloads)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/iii-sdk?label=PyPI&logo=pypi&logoColor=white)](https://pypi.org/project/iii-sdk/) [![PyPI downloads](https://img.shields.io/pypi/dm/iii-sdk?label=PyPI%20downloads)](https://pypistats.org/packages/iii-sdk) [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/iii-sdk?logo=rust)](https://crates.io/crates/iii-sdk) [![docs.rs](https://img.shields.io/docsrs/iii-sdk?logo=docsdotrs)](https://docs.rs/iii-sdk) [![Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii) [![Docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/iiidev/iii?logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://hub.docker.com/r/iiidev/iii) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1322278831184281721?label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/iiidev) [![X](https://img.shields.io/twitter/follow/iiidevs?style=flat&logo=x)](https://x.com/iiidevs) [Website](https://iii.dev) · [Docs](https://iii.dev/docs) · [Quickstart](https://iii.dev/docs/quickstart) · [Worker registry](https://iii.dev/registry) · [Blog](https://iii.dev/blog) · [Manifesto](https://iii.dev/manifesto) English | [简体中文](README_zh.md)
## Why iii Every service comes with its own runtime, API, and failure modes. Getting services to work together means endless integration and instrumentation work: error handling, gateways, sync, tracing, and maintenance that never stops. It's estimated that up to 70% of development time is dedicated to integrations. 40% is the lowest estimate we could find. iii removes that work with one primitive, the **Function**. Services, agents, and tools connect to one engine as workers, and everything they can do is a Function that any other worker can call or observe, in any language and on any machine. Workers can then be defined in a Compose file and run on any infrastructure. An entire service stack can be brought up, down, upgraded, or swapped out with ease. iii is like having an entire app platform at your fingertips without the vendor lock-in. The result is a system that is composable, observable, discoverable, extensible, and reactive. See [Built for C.O.D.E.R.](#built-for-coder). ## One primitive: the Function iii organizes software around one primitive, the **Function**, and two operators: - `worker.call(a)` runs function `a` now. - `worker.observe(a, b)` makes function `b` run when function `a` runs. Workers host functions. Queues, databases, HTTP, streaming, sandboxes, observability, agents, and business logic are all functions. An HTTP request is a call of `http::on-request`. A database write is a call of `database::on-row-changed`. A queue message is a call of `queue::on-message`. To react to any of them, you use the same `observe`. ```typescript import { registerWorker } from 'iii-sdk' const worker = registerWorker('ws://localhost:49134') worker.registerFunction('orders::create', async (order: { item: string; total: number }) => { return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), ...order } }) worker.registerFunction('alerts::big-order', async ({ input }: { input: { total: number } }) => { console.log(`Big order: ${input.total}`) }) // When orders::create runs with a total of 500 or more, alerts::big-order runs const observer = worker.observe( { function_id: 'orders::create', filters: { 'input.total': { $gte: 500 } } }, 'alerts::big-order', ) await observer.ready() // Run orders::create now and wait for its result const order = await worker.call({ function_id: 'orders::create', payload: { item: 'widget', total: 750 } }) console.log(order) ``` The same API is in every SDK. See [sdk/README.md](sdk/README.md). ## Built for C.O.D.E.R. | | Property | What you get | | --- | --- | --- | | **C** | Composability | Functions in different languages and locations work together seamlessly. | | **O** | Observability | One trace follows every execution step across languages and machines. Export over OTLP. | | **D** | Discoverability | The engine holds a live registry of every Function. It's always up to date so developers and agents have a clear picture. | | **E** | Extensibility | Workers can be added and removed at any time with a single command. | | **R** | Reactivity | Anything can be an observer or observed. Reactivity and events do not need to be pre-planned. | ## Install ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh ``` The installer asks to set up your first project. Press Enter, then open http://127.0.0.1:3113. For CI, Docker builds, and scripts, install without the prompt: ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --non-interactive ``` The [install guide](https://iii.dev/docs/install) has all installer options. ## Quickstart In one terminal, create and start a project: ```bash iii project init my-app && cd my-app iii compose --up # start the engine and the project's workers; keep it running ``` In a second terminal, add a worker from the registry: ```bash cd my-app iii call compose::add worker=http ``` The engine listens on `ws://localhost:49134`. The console serves at http://127.0.0.1:3113. Continue with the [Quickstart](https://iii.dev/docs/quickstart). ## SDKs | Language | Package | Install | | --- | --- | --- | | TypeScript (Node.js) | [`iii-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-sdk` | | TypeScript (browser) | [`iii-browser-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-browser-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-browser-sdk` | | Python | [`iii-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/iii-sdk/) | `pip install iii-sdk` | | Rust | [`iii-sdk`](https://crates.io/crates/iii-sdk) | `cargo add iii-sdk` | | Go | [`iii`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii) | `go get github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii` | ## Repository structure | Path | Contents | | --- | --- | | [`engine/`](engine/README.md) | Rust engine and `iii` CLI | | [`sdk/`](sdk/README.md) | SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go | | [`docs/`](docs/README.md) | Documentation source for [iii.dev/docs](https://iii.dev/docs) (Mintlify) | | [`website/`](website/README.md) | Source for [iii.dev](https://iii.dev) | | [`skills/`](skills/) | Agent skills for coding agents | | [`tech-specs/`](tech-specs/) | Technical specifications | ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, commands, and the contribution license terms. ```bash pnpm install && pnpm build # JS/TS packages cargo build --release # engine and Rust SDK pnpm test && cargo test # tests ``` Report bugs and request features in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/issues). ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/iiidev): questions and discussion - [X](https://x.com/iiidevs) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/iii-dev): news - [Blog](https://iii.dev/blog): architecture posts and worked examples - [Roadmap](https://iii.dev/roadmap): what comes next ## License - `engine/` (engine and CLI): [Elastic License 2.0](engine/LICENSE) - iii Workers, docs, and SDKs: [Apache License 2.0](sdk/LICENSE) All contributions are made under Apache 2.0. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#license-of-contributions) for full contribution and licensing details.

## 为什么选择 iii 每个服务都有自己的运行时、API 和故障方式。让服务协同工作意味着没完没了的集成和埋点工作：错误处理、网关、同步、链路追踪，以及永无止境的维护。 据估计，多达 70% 的开发时间花在集成上。我们能找到的最低估计也有 40%。 iii 用一个原语 **Function** 消除这些工作。服务、智能体和工具作为 worker 连接到同一个引擎，它们能做的一切都是 Function，任何其他 worker 都可以调用（call）或观察（observe）它，不论使用什么语言、运行在哪台机器上。worker 可以定义在 Compose 文件中，并运行在任何基础设施上。整个服务栈可以轻松地启动、停止、升级或替换。 iii 就像把一整个应用平台握在手中，却没有供应商锁定。结果是一个可组合、可观测、可发现、可扩展且具备响应能力的系统。参见[为 C.O.D.E.R. 而构建](#为-coder-而构建)。 ## 一个原语：Function iii 围绕一个原语 **Function** 和两个操作来组织软件： - `worker.call(a)` 立即运行函数 `a`。 - `worker.observe(a, b)` 使函数 `a` 运行时，函数 `b` 也运行。 worker 托管函数。队列、数据库、HTTP、流、沙箱、可观测性、智能体和业务逻辑都是函数。一个 HTTP 请求是对 `http::on-request` 的一次调用。一次数据库写入是对 `database::on-row-changed` 的一次调用。一条队列消息是对 `queue::on-message` 的一次调用。要响应其中任何一个，都使用同一个 `observe`。 ```typescript import { registerWorker } from 'iii-sdk' const worker = registerWorker('ws://localhost:49134') worker.registerFunction('orders::create', async (order: { item: string; total: number }) => { return { id: crypto.randomUUID(), ...order } }) worker.registerFunction('alerts::big-order', async ({ input }: { input: { total: number } }) => { console.log(`Big order: ${input.total}`) }) // When orders::create runs with a total of 500 or more, alerts::big-order runs const observer = worker.observe( { function_id: 'orders::create', filters: { 'input.total': { $gte: 500 } } }, 'alerts::big-order', ) await observer.ready() // Run orders::create now and wait for its result const order = await worker.call({ function_id: 'orders::create', payload: { item: 'widget', total: 750 } }) console.log(order) ``` 每个 SDK 都提供相同的 API。参见 [sdk/README.md](sdk/README.md)。 ## 为 C.O.D.E.R. 而构建 | | 特性 | 你得到什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | **C** | 可组合性（Composability） | 不同语言、不同位置的函数无缝协同工作。 | | **O** | 可观测性（Observability） | 一条 trace 跨语言、跨机器跟踪每一个执行步骤。可通过 OTLP 导出。 | | **D** | 可发现性（Discoverability） | 引擎维护所有 Function 的实时注册表。它始终保持最新，让开发者和智能体对系统一目了然。 | | **E** | 可扩展性（Extensibility） | 只需一条命令，就可以随时添加或移除 worker。 | | **R** | 响应性（Reactivity） | 任何东西都可以是观察者或被观察者。响应和事件不需要预先规划。 | ## 安装 ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh ``` 安装程序会询问是否设置你的第一个项目。按 Enter，然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:3113。 在 CI、Docker 构建和脚本中，可以不经提示直接安装： ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.iii.dev/iii/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --non-interactive ``` [安装指南](https://iii.dev/docs/install)列出了所有安装选项。 ## 快速入门 在第一个终端中创建并启动项目： ```bash iii project init my-app && cd my-app iii compose --up # start the engine and the project's workers; keep it running ``` 在第二个终端中从注册表添加一个 worker： ```bash cd my-app iii call compose::add worker=http ``` 引擎监听 `ws://localhost:49134`。控制台运行在 http://127.0.0.1:3113。下一步请阅读[快速入门](https://iii.dev/docs/quickstart)。 ## SDK | 语言 | 包 | 安装 | | --- | --- | --- | | TypeScript（Node.js） | [`iii-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-sdk` | | TypeScript（浏览器） | [`iii-browser-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/iii-browser-sdk) | `pnpm add iii-browser-sdk` | | Python | [`iii-sdk`](https://pypi.org/project/iii-sdk/) | `pip install iii-sdk` | | Rust | [`iii-sdk`](https://crates.io/crates/iii-sdk) | `cargo add iii-sdk` | | Go | [`iii`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii) | `go get github.com/iii-hq/iii/sdk/packages/go/iii` | ## 仓库结构 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [`engine/`](engine/README.md) | Rust 引擎和 `iii` CLI | | [`sdk/`](sdk/README.md) | TypeScript、Python、Rust 和 Go 的 SDK | | [`docs/`](docs/README.md) | [iii.dev/docs](https://iii.dev/docs) 的文档源码（Mintlify） | | [`website/`](website/README.md) | [iii.dev](https://iii.dev) 的源码 | | [`skills/`](skills/) | 面向编码智能体的 agent skills | | [`tech-specs/`](tech-specs/) | 技术规范 | ## 贡献 欢迎贡献。请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 了解环境设置、命令和贡献许可条款。 ```bash pnpm install && pnpm build # JS/TS packages cargo build --release # engine and Rust SDK pnpm test && cargo test # tests ``` 请在 [GitHub issues](https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/issues) 中报告 bug 和提出功能请求。 ## 社区 - [Discord](https://discord.gg/iiidev)：提问与讨论 - [X](https://x.com/iiidevs) 和 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/iii-dev)：新闻 - [博客](https://iii.dev/blog)：架构文章和完整示例 - [路线图](https://iii.dev/roadmap)：后续计划 ## 许可证 - `engine/`（引擎和 CLI）：[Elastic License 2.0](engine/LICENSE) - iii worker、文档和 SDK：[Apache License 2.0](sdk/LICENSE) 所有贡献均以 Apache 2.0 许可提交。完整的贡献和许可说明参见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#license-of-contributions)。
